title: Socketed spearhead
source_title: File:A complete cast iron spearhead, of probable Medieval date. (FindID 87221).jpg
creator: Birmingham Museums Trust, Caroline Johnson, 2005-02-10 15:48:53
credit: https://finds.org.uk/database/ajax/download/id/50970  Catalog:  https://finds.org.uk/database/images/image/id/50970/recordtype/artefacts    archive copy  at the    Wayback Machine     Artefact:  https://finds.org.uk/database/artefacts/record/id/87221

source_description: A complete cast iron spearhead, of probable Medieval date (length: 120mm; width at blade: 20.4mm; thickness of blade: 8.4mm; diameter of end of shank: 17.3mm; weight: 56.95g).  The rounded wings of the blade are uneven to either side, with the rib clearly visible down the centre.  The shaft is hollow and in a one piece without a split to the side, like with Anglo Saxon types, indicating that this artefact is probably later.  There are possible remains of an iron rivet to the end of the shank, where the spearhead would have been fastened onto a wooden shaft.  The artefact is worn and in a corroded condition.
